description: (Re)run asynchronous audio processing on a registered remote post, as reprocessPost does for a hosted one. Processing state is Antiphony's own and outside the record, which stays in its repo unchanged.

main.description: Requests processing stages for a registered remote post's audio and returns the view. Stage results arrive by webhook (`stage.settled`, with `uri`). Tenant-level: a service token is enough, no acting actor.

processing.description: The stages to run. A request enabling no stage is rejected (InvalidRequest) rather than treated as a no-op.

errors.name: RemotePostNotFound
errors.description: The calling tenant has not registered this URI.
